message:
Wedding Catering Styles: Plated, Buffet, Family-Style or Stations

Pick the feel first:
• Plated is formal and needs more staff.
• Buffet is relaxed and lets guests choose.
• Family-style sits in between and gets people talking.
• Stations suit a lively, mingling reception.

Then compare total cost. The lowest per-plate price often isn't the lowest total once staff, rentals and service charges appear.
